title: An approximate tangent plane makes the off-plane mass in B_ρ(x) o(ρⁿ) (blow-up step of Simon 6.3)
statement: Let n, ℓ be natural numbers, V a rectifiable n-varifold in E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} whose weight μ = μ_V is finite on compact sets, and x ∈ E. Let P be a linear subspace of E that is an approximate tangent space of V at x (V.IsApproxTangentAt x P), and let ε > 0. Then ρ^{−n}·μ.real(B_ρ(x) ∖ {y : dist(y − x, P) < ερ}) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0. Here B_ρ(x) is the closed ball, dist(·, P) = infDist(·, P), ρ^{−n} = (ρⁿ)⁻¹ and μ.real(A) = (μ(A)).toReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (x : Ambient n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)) (ε : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → V.IsApproxTangentAt x P → 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * V.weight.real (closedBall x ρ \ {y | infDist (y - x) (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) < ε * ρ})) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
